pump1.basis: User-reported collection: 4.1 mL in 5 s; corrected total 8.2 mL in 10 s

pump2.basis: Assumed equal to Pump 1 at user direction; not separately measured

pump3.basis: Assumed equal to Pump 1 at user direction; not separately measured

control_use: Reservoir volume corrected by user from 20 L to 12.5 L. Provisional pulse and cumulative caps were multiplied by 12.5/20 to retain the previous mL-per-liter upper bounds. The user reported three 1.22 s deliveries at 1 mL, but did not specify whether these were three Pump 1 trials or one trial for each pump. The 2 L sequential chemical test is not a dose-response calibration for the 12.5 L operating reservoir. These limits do not predict a final pH or EC.
